steps.title: Multi-Tenant Architecture
steps.text: Multiple tenants share the same Surgewave cluster through a gateway layer that handles authentication, authorization, and rate limiting, with topic namespaces providing logical isolation.

steps.title: Isolation Levels
steps.text: Choose from shared everything (low cost, no isolation), namespace isolation (balanced cost and logical separation), or dedicated clusters (high cost, full physical isolation).

steps.title: Tenant-Aware Patterns
steps.text: Use TenantContext to prefix topic names and consumer group IDs automatically. Tenant-aware producers route messages to the correct namespaced topics.

steps.title: Resource Management
steps.text: Allocate resources per tenant with topic namespace prefixes, partition limits, throughput rate limiting, storage quotas, and connection limits.

steps.title: Monitoring per Tenant
steps.text: Track per-tenant metrics including messages per second, bytes per second, partition counts, and quota utilization to ensure fair resource allocation.
